preview.note: Each large and small image is sampled from the same single generated design. These are concept references, not PixelLab production sprites.

sharedStyle: Original seven-to-eight-year-old chibi children, oversized rounded heads, front-facing low top-down view. Dark chestnut hair, kind sparkling eyes, white school shirts, navy skirts for girls or navy shorts for boys, short close-hanging sun-gold capes, white socks and brown school shoes. Dark continuous outlines, broad coherent hair highlights, no hair over eyes or cheeks. No profession or weapon.

options.label: ก
options.name: Low braids
options.hair: Two neat low braids hanging just behind the shoulders, center-parted crown, both cheeks completely clear; small navy ties.
options.eyes: Large round warm-brown eyes, both equally open, each with a matching white sparkle.
options.eyebrows: Soft shallow curved brows, level and relaxed.
options.outfit: White collared shirt, navy pleated skirt, narrow short gold cape, white ankle socks, brown Mary Jane shoes.

options.label: ข
options.name: Straight hair and headband
options.hair: Smooth straight shoulder-length hair tucked behind the ears, narrow navy headband, clear forehead and cheeks.
options.eyes: Wide oval warm-brown eyes, equal size and openness, bright matching catchlights.
options.outfit: White collared shirt, navy A-line skirt with two front pleats, narrow short gold cape, white socks, rounded brown shoes.

options.label: ค
options.name: Rounded bob and clip
options.hair: Rounded chin-length bob with ends turned inward, fringe swept above the eyebrows, one small navy side clip; no hair over either eye or cheek.

options.eyebrows: Low soft curved brows with no inward slant.
options.outfit: White short-sleeve shirt, navy pleated skirt, narrow short gold cape, white ankle socks, brown strap shoes.

options.label: ง

options.mouth: Small cheerful smile with a tiny glimpse of teeth.
options.outfit: White school shirt with a navy necktie, navy pleated skirt, short gold cape, white socks and rounded brown shoes.

options.label: จ

options.name: Soft tousled crop

options.name: Neat side part
